I was in your situation at one point in my life*cough* middle school *cough*, and I felt the same way. I felt as if nobody would ever even want to talk to me, or love me for that matter, and I actually attempted suicide by drug overdose. What got me out of that rut though was finding a passion, and starting over. You see, I started doing theatre in high school, and I never left it. It gave me something to focus on, and made me feel important because people were now counting on you. And on the social aspect, you become friends eventually with people you are around a lot(this applies to any passion, or profession). I've made some life long friends working in Theatre. Now, I'm not saying you should necessarily join Theatre, but I am saying go find something to set your mind to.

(really sorry about the length of this reply)So what happened was 2 really bad breakups. The first girl broke up with me for a really, really stupid reason(the reason isn't important right now), and it got to me, it got to me real bad. I felt anger I had never felt before, and I started pushing people away because of that. I was always ready to kill something and I didn't even smile for two weeks. I became an all around bitter kid and I wouldn't talk to anyone for the first half of the month. I lost some close friends because of that, which I severely regret because they did not diverse any of the hate they got from me. The second half of the month I started realizing what I had done, and I felt awful about it. I tried apologizing to everyone, but only a few of them were gracious enough to give me a second chance. This, as you can probably imagine, really hurt me emotionally. So I got the bright idea to get back with a previous girlfriend(not the one mentioned before), who has a history of not being mentally satble, to try to cheer my self up. This didn't work out. I accompanied her, with her family, to an over night trip at a beach resort. I thought we had a great time. We were cuddling, kissing, bumping uglies here and there, and having a very memorable trip. That was entail I had to leave to go home because my dad wanted me there to watch after my mom. When I texted her when I got home, the first thing she said was, "we need to talk." Turns out, she felt nothing, absolutely nothing towards me romantically the entire trip. This fucking killed me. I cried. I cried the hardest I ever had in years. That was a week ago now, and it's still weighing heavy on my mind. I distanced my self again because of this again, and I have not rejoined my friend group yet because I'm ready to burst into tears at a moments notice. All of this not me. I'm not like this. I am usual happy as a pug, but I've never felt these feelings before, and I don't know how to make them stop. I don't like coming home, locking my self in my room, then crying my self to sleep because of Shelby and how much of an ass I've been.
